scope.selection: The 49 native spirit definitions absent from the pinned main inventory: 48 AVI-prefixed ideas plus E_E_rivalry. Industrial concern avithreehousescorp excluded.
scope.status: Semantic briefs only. No images generated or bindings approved.

description_policy: Resolved English localization is preserved when present, including native formatting codes. For 27 spirits without localized descriptions, description is an explicitly authored synopsis using current effects and the related focus context; localized_description is null and description_origin identifies the fallback. These summaries do not alter game localization. Never render source prose or formatting codes as icon lettering.

art_direction.style: Painted HOI4/EaW object icons, one dominant silhouette and at most two supporting motifs; readable at 64x64.
art_direction.background: Transparent exterior; no opaque scene panels or repeated generic branch badges.
art_direction.prohibitions: No humans, human hands, invented heraldry, arbitrary crowns or lilies, external franchise insignia, blank seals/documents or pseudo-text. Books and charts must contain meaningful diagrams or tallies. No proposed brief requires a flag or crown.
art_direction.variants: DLC variants represent the same institutions. Distinguish apparatus and composition without inventing separate agencies. Academy and currency tiers must remain visually distinguishable.

semantic_notes: Fifteen of these native ideas also feed the unified-spirit component ledger. That does not eliminate the separate native definitions or make their individual icons complete.
E_E_rivalry is the shared Erie/Eyrie feud. Its native starting-state description must not be read as a statement that later reconciliation is impossible.
The Foundation's native description establishes clandestine containment; it does not establish a named anomaly or external franchise logo.
AVI_opposable_thumbs has an empty modifier block and no scoped exact-ID use in the audit. Its description's claimed bonuses are not implemented by this definition.

records.name: Erie-Eyrie Rivalry
records.description:
§RTwo households, both alike in dignity,
From ancient grudge break to new mutiny,
Where civil blood makes civil claws unclean.§!
§W--------------§!
The bitter feud between the rival houses of Eyrie and Erie - both houses as irreconcilable to each other as the Sun and Moon, Day and Night - has led to decades of incessant internecine violence between the two heavily militarised houses. Both leaders of the houses claim to be the rightful and legitimate Dukes of Verenia, and both of them refuse to negotiate with each other. The violence will likely continue until one side proves triumphant.

records.name: Interhouse Economic Cooperation
records.description: Cooperation among the Houses improves construction, production capacity and access to local resources.
records.brief: Three different construction beams fitted into one load-bearing joint, with a mineral basket beneath.

records.name: Interhouse Student Exchange Programmes
records.description: Interhouse student exchanges broaden access to learning and modestly accelerate research.
records.brief: A travelling school satchel opened to an illustrated geometry book, with two differently coloured destination tags.

records.name: The Avian Scientific Exchange Conference
records.description: The Avian Scientific Exchange Conference brings together the brightest minds from across the Three Houses for a months-long scientific conference in Avian. No doubt this conference will be a boon to the scientific communities of all parties involved, but the concentrated presence of so many foreign minds in one place will entail some substantial security concerns ...
records.localized_description: The Avian Scientific Exchange Conference brings together the brightest minds from across the Three Houses for a months-long scientific conference in Avian. No doubt this conference will be a boon to the scientific communities of all parties involved, but the concentrated presence of so many foreign minds in one place will entail some substantial security concerns ...
records.brief: A conference microscope between three delegate stools, with its instrument case left visibly unlocked.

records.name: Relaxed Citizenship Requirements
records.description: Relaxed citizenship requirements permit easier settlement and increase population growth.
records.brief: An open residence gate framing a family travel trunk and a newly lit home window.

records.name: Tripartite Common Market Agreement
records.description: The ratification of the Tripartite Common Market Agreement by the Three Houses has officially allowed for the close integration of their national economies, boosting economic growth by enforcing protectionist policies against foreign nations whilst greatly liberalising trade between the Three Houses. Although there arises from time to time occasional skirmishes or border wars between Houses Erie and Eyrie, the neutral House Avian acts as an arbitrator and so prevents the agreement from falling apart - an advantageous, if somewhat convoluted, state of affairs that all three Houses, despite their differences, are happy to maintain.
records.localized_description: The ratification of the Tripartite Common Market Agreement by the Three Houses has officially allowed for the close integration of their national economies, boosting economic growth by enforcing protectionist policies against foreign nations whilst greatly liberalising trade between the Three Houses. Although there arises from time to time occasional skirmishes or border wars between Houses Erie and Eyrie, the neutral House Avian acts as an arbitrator and so prevents the agreement from falling apart - an advantageous, if somewhat convoluted, state of affairs that all three Houses, despite their differences, are happy to maintain.
records.brief: A three-stall market enclosed by one outer tariff rail, its internal toll chains laid aside.
records.lore_notes: Preserve the native description's economic integration and Avian arbitration; no annexation, unified flag or claim that all rivalry has ended.

records.name: Annual Military Exercises
records.description: Recurring joint exercises improve command capacity, mobilisation, planning and military participation.

records.name: Agricultural Sustainability
records.description: A more dependable agricultural supply supports sustainable production and a higher factory efficiency ceiling.
records.brief: A stout grain bin with a carefully fitted lid and a single ripe sheaf at its base.

records.name: Everygriff a Farmer
records.description: Wider participation in farming strengthens production efficiency and the use of local resources.
records.brief: A seed drill sharing its axle with a simple workshop wheel, a basket of locally gathered materials below.

records.name: Closed Agro-Ecosystem
records.description: House Avian has managed to create and maintain an entirely self-sufficient agricultural and ecological system within their realm, thus negating their dependence on external imports of food.
records.localized_description: House Avian has managed to create and maintain an entirely self-sufficient agricultural and ecological system within their realm, thus negating their dependence on external imports of food.
records.brief: A closed-loop irrigation channel surrounding a productive farm plot and a full granary.

records.name: Cooperative Farms
records.description: Farm cooperatives ease civilian economic demands and support household population growth.
records.brief: A communal produce hamper beneath a shared threshing rake, three farm lanes meeting underneath.

records.name: Avian Protectionism
records.description: Protective trade arrangements reduce export obligations and the consumer-goods burden.
records.brief: A customs shutter shielding a domestic market scale, with an export crate held on the inner side.

records.name: State-Capital Collusion
records.description: State-capital collusion lowers the political cost of changing trade and economic laws.
records.brief: A state treasury key interlocked with a private factory key over an economic policy dial.
records.lore_notes: Localized title says Collusion. Portray privileged state-capital coordination, not a neutral public welfare agency.

records.name: Militarised Society
records.description: Widespread basic military training increases the recruitable population share and shortens training.
records.brief: A household training whistle hanging above a practice rifle and an everyday work apron.

records.name: Militarised Society - Mandatory Service
records.description: All citizens of House Avian, be they nobles or commoners, have to undergo two years of compulsory military service.
records.localized_description: All citizens of House Avian, be they nobles or commoners, have to undergo two years of compulsory military service.
records.brief: A complete service pack flanked by two annual calendar discs, its cartridge belt fastened tight.

records.name: Fortification Effort
records.description: A coordinated fortification effort speeds bunker construction.
records.brief: A concrete bunker mould with reinforcing rods and a mason's trowel.

records.name: Decentralised Arsenal
records.description: The decentralisation of the House Avian arsenal and the distribution of weapon caches all over the Avian realm ensures that potent armed resistance may continue even when the House's main supply depots and armouries are overrun.
records.localized_description: The decentralisation of the House Avian arsenal and the distribution of weapon caches all over the Avian realm ensures that potent armed resistance may continue even when the House's main supply depots and armouries are overrun.
records.brief: A cutaway hillside weapons cache behind a closed supply-road barrier, a second cache visible beyond.

records.name: Guns for Gilda
records.description: A programme to modernise older weapons increases equipment-conversion speed.
records.brief: A gunsmith's conversion vise holding an old rifle action beside its newly machined replacement.

records.name: Militia Army
records.description: A larger citizen militia increases recruitment but takes longer to train and is less organised.

records.description: Declared neutrality discourages aggression and foreign subversion while strengthening ideological and counterintelligence defences.

records.name: Liberty!
records.description: Civic liberty supports productive efficiency and improves foreign trade relations.

records.name: Linguistic Antagonism
records.description: Although the nobility of House Avian utilise the Imperial Dialect as their lingua franca, the languages spoken by the commoners range from the Herzland dialect to Aquileian. The lack of linguistic uniformity obfuscates communication and further ingrains cultural strife.
